scope: Local startup-preservation regression only; no deployment, browser, production database or provider requests.

verified_regression.actual_normalization_risk: Existing underscore slugs such as existing_guide and case_study were normalized to hyphens by the obsolete startup migration.
verified_regression.unicode_correction: The existing _slug function already preserves Unicode. Unicode URL continuity is tested, but Unicode stripping was not the reproduced bug.
verified_regression.schedulers_storage_and_external_setup: Local stubs; scheduled coroutines recorded and closed without running.

warnings: Two installed Starlette dependency deprecation warnings.

limitations: This prevents future automatic source migrations and resurrection after deployment; no live MongoDB documents were inspected, repaired or overwritten.
Startup still performs its existing administrator/index/scheduler/storage setup. The preservation fixture uses an already configured administrator and verifies zero document writes.
